**What we feature during our live shows**
In addition to the usual game(s) that are part of the program, we also feature various other games to fill in the runtime. On the Friday Fun Night Show, we feature Bigjon's Deal or No Deal, Set for Life, and Wheel of Fortune, as well as the Sorry! PC game. When we feature that game, we play the popular Duel Monsters trading card game against several characters from the franchise that some of you may remember. Characters such as Yugi Motou, Seto Kaiba, Joey Wheeler, Jaden Yuki, Yusei Fudo, Yuma Tsukumo, & Yuya Sakaki. This game as it's own live show is currently set to replace Roblox, which will conclude at the end of this year. When we feature Bigjon's Wheel of Fortune, we also feature a new segment of it which we introduced last year called "The Random Character Extravaganza". It was launched in July 2021, rebroadcasting severe weather event timelines and only ran for certain hours of the day. When original programming was introduced to the main channel, severe weather event archives stopped airing in favor of the all original programming format.
